payload.name: Modality Effect
payload.fact: Students learn better when verbal input is presented auditorily as speech rather than visually as text.

provenance.title: Cognitive principles of multimedia learning: The role of modality and contiguity.
provenance.quote_or_locus: Both experiments revealed a modality effect in which students learned better when verbal input was presented auditorily as speech rather than visually as text
